A hysteroscopy is an advanced technique that helps the physicians to view the interior of the uterus without having to cut into the area to do so. In accordance with the condition being treated, the procedure helps to detect or treat a range of uterine disorders.

With Seeds of Innocence Surgical Centre, the patients receive specialized evaluation and minimally invasive surgical treatment for a wide variety of gynecological disorders. Understanding the procedure and what affects the cost of hysteroscopy in Delhi will be helpful for the patients.

What is Hysteroscopy?

Hysteroscopy is a process where a thin tube, known as hysteroscope, is inserted through the vagina and cervix into the uterus. The hysteroscope contains a camera and a light source enabling the surgeon to visualize the inner lining of the uterine cavity.

Unlike conventional surgery, hysteroscopy does not involve making an incision on the abdomen. It may be done either for diagnosis or treatment purposes.

Types of Hysteroscopy:

There are mainly two types of hysteroscopy.

Diagnostic Hysteroscopy

Diagnostic hysteroscopy is done to check the uterus for any potential abnormalities. It is recommended when a patient has any of the following problems:

  • Unusual or excessive menstrual bleeding
  • Irregular menstruation
  • Recurring miscarriages
  • Problems getting pregnant
  • Suspected uterine polyps
  • Suspected presence of fibroids within the uterus
  • Uterine adhesions or scar tissue
  • Congenital deformities of the uterus
  • The cost of the hysteroscopy test in Delhi is dependent on several factors.

Operative Hysteroscopy

An operative hysteroscopy is done in case the doctor has to treat a particular condition that exists within the process. In some cases, the surgeon may remove uterine polyps, certain types of fibroids, and adhesions.

Since operative procedures might require special equipment, anaesthesia, an operating room, and more skilled surgeons, the hysteroscopy price in Delhi is higher for an operative hysteroscopy as compared to diagnostic procedures.

Hysteroscopy Cost in Delhi: What Affects the Price?

The most common question that patients ask in this context is, "What is the hysteroscopy cost in Delhi?"

There is not one single price since a number of factors influence the cost of the procedure. It is important to understand the contents of the treatment package before taking the final decision.

1. Facility for Surgery

The place where the hysteroscopy is to be carried out could be one of the determining factors for the cost of hysteroscopy in Delhi. This could include the use of modern equipment, operation theater facilities, infection control measures, nursing services and after care.

2. Expertise of the Hysteroscopy Surgeon in Delhi

The expertise and experience of the treating physician could also be considered. An experienced hysteroscopy surgeon in Delhi will be able to assess the condition of the patient and suggest the most suitable approach for carrying out the hysteroscopy procedure. Patients should never select a surgery procedure simply based on cost. The expertise, credentials of the treating doctor, hospital facilities and level of care should all be considered.

3. Fees for Anaesthesia

Depending upon the kind of procedure and the health of the patient, some hysteroscopies could involve the use of general, local or regional anaesthesia. These fees might be included in the overall package or charged separately.

4. Other Tests and Investigation Procedures

Before performing a hysteroscopy, there might be other blood, imaging and investigative procedures that have to be performed by the patient.

Treatment Required During the Procedure

There might be cases where during the process of diagnosis through hysteroscopy, something else could turn up that would require a treatment procedure. The process of removing polyps, fibroids, adhesions, and other abnormalities may require additional fees.

This means that it is important to discuss the hysteroscopy cost in Delhi with the medical practitioner to see whether the price includes the cost of the diagnostic process, surgery, anaesthesia, medicine, and postoperative care.

When Is Hysteroscopy Recommended?

It might happen that your healthcare provider will recommend you this procedure in case other procedures cannot identify what is going on in the uterus.

The hysteroscopy process could help diagnose or treat:

Uterine Polyps

These are abnormal growths found in the mucous membrane layer of the uterus. They depend on the size and position of the polyp to cause abnormal bleeding or fertility problems.

Submucosal Fibroids

Some fibroids grow into the cavity of the uterus causing heavy bleeding, pain, and reproductive problems. Hysteroscopic surgery could remove some selected fibroids without opening the abdomen.

Uterine Adhesions

Scar tissue inside the uterus could affect the period or fertility. Hysteroscopy makes it possible to examine and treat certain adhesions.

Abnormal Uterine Bleeding

Patients who have unexplained or persistent abnormal uterine bleeding may require hysteroscopy in order to determine any abnormalities within the uterus.

Fertility and Reproductive Issues

In some cases, women being evaluated for fertility issues may require hysteroscopy in order to diagnose uterine problems that can impact conception or pregnancy.

Advantages of Hysteroscopy

There are certain benefits to hysteroscopy over other surgical methods that involve larger incisions in the body.

Some of these benefits can include:

  • No large abdominal cut
  • Direct viewing of the uterus
  • Diagnosis and therapy can often be done in one surgery
  • Little to no scarring
  • Faster recovery time in many cases
  • Hospital stay can be shorter for appropriate patients
  • Increased accuracy in treatment of certain uterine problems

However, not all women are appropriate for hysteroscopy. Consulting an expert specialist is necessary prior to treatment.

Factors to Consider When Choosing a Hysteroscopy Surgeon in Delhi

Some of those things include:

3. Difference between diagnostic and operative hysteroscopy?

Hysteroscopy that is performed with the objective of diagnosing problems related to uterus such as polyps, fibroids, adhesions or other problems is known as diagnostic hysteroscopy. On the other hand, hysteroscopy that is performed with the objective of treating some conditions such as removal of polyps, certain fibroids or uterine adhesions is called operative hysteroscopy.

5. Does hysteroscopy cause any pain?

It depends on the type of hysteroscopy and on the person. Some diagnostic procedures might involve some cramps or discomfort. Operative hysteroscopy can be performed under anesthesia.
